title: ADR 037 — Tauri Convergence
summary: Desktop-mobile application convergence on Tauri 2; mobile-target clause partially superseded by adr-NNN, desktop convergence remains Accepted.
notes: Partially superseded: mobile-target clause no longer valid (Tauri does not cover mobile-android/mobile-ios; React Native + Expo handles mobile). Desktop-convergence decision remains Accepted and active. Document mixes still-valid and superseded content; treated as unlocked overall.
